'''Reflections Gold''' is the cancelled Decipher product that got closest to existing. CardGuide numbers it #37 (this wiki; CardGuide #36 before Death Star II starters were split out). Decipher had Lucasfilm-approved art for about 200 cards and wanted to print a last Reflections set before the Star Wars license ended. They ran out of time to playtest. After the license expired they asked Lucasfilm for permission to post the cards as a free PDF; Lucasfilm said no.<ref name="holland">[https://web.archive.org/web/20080207033202/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/reflectionsgold.html Reflections Gold announcement] at Decipher.com (archive, 7 February 2008)</ref><ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2]</ref>

Warren Holland's public note, 25 January 2002:

<blockquote>
As I previously announced, it was Decipher's desire to "give" players 200 ''Star Wars'' CCG cards (in PDF format on our web site) that had already been approved by Lucasfilm for Reflections Gold. We saw this as a gift to players for all their support throughout the years. We were not able to print these cards as we had hoped, but we didn't want to see all the art and gameplay go to waste.

I am sorry to announce that Lucasfilm has just rejected the idea of us releasing these cards for free on the web. Unfortunately, we will never be able to show these cards to the general public. We don't agree with this decision by Lucasfilm, but we have to abide by it. Sorry.

Warren Holland, Chairman & CEO, Decipher Inc.
</blockquote>

Playtest copies still left Decipher: images printed on sticker stock and stuck to white-border cards. A near-complete set reached the secondary market in 2006, was partly destroyed in a household accident, and the remaining extras plus scans went to Category One Games and the Players Committee.<ref name="c1">[https://blog.categoryonegames.com/reflectionsgold/ Reflections Gold] at Category One Games</ref><ref name="forum">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?f=87&t=18282 Reflections Gold, Playtest, Signed, Cards etc] at forum.starwarsccg.org</ref>

== Three card types ==
Contemporary write-ups (Category One, CardGuide, and the first post of the PC forum thread) agree on three mechanics. None of them were playtested to a finished rulebook.<ref name="c1" /><ref name="cg">[https://web.archive.org/web/20250222210013/https://cardguide.fandom.com/wiki/Reflections_Gold_(expansion) Reflections Gold (expansion)] at CardGuide Wiki (archive, 22 February 2025)</ref>

* '''Credits''' — a player would start with 4 or 5 credit points and could keep matching "wide vision" cards in the opening hand. Each of those cards showed a gold diamond value in the lower right. Category One describes them as existing cards with the image turned sideways.
* '''Combo cards''' — interrupt and effect pairs in the Reflections II / Coruscant style, widely described as overpowered because the two halves were already strong alone (the usual example on the forum is Beggar & Revolution).
* '''Blank cards''' — new frames with an empty text box. Decipher's idea was that the coming Players Committee could rotate printed text into those boxes every few months. That plan is the ancestor of virtual cards; after Lucasfilm refused the PDF giveaway, the PC built virtual cards without Decipher's pre-printed blanks.<ref name="c1" />

== How the copies survived ==
Category One's 2000s write-up: a former seller close to Decipher staff sold extras in late 2006, then reported that an accident destroyed most of a full set. Leftover extras went to Category One. The same source says the seller later gave the Players Committee a scan of each card. Printing quality on the sticker playtests is poor; because they were barely tested, surviving copies are often in good physical shape.<ref name="c1" />

The PC forum thread (t=18282) is the messy original dump of those scans: Category One photobucket albums under <code>Star Wars/Ref Gold/</code>, mixed with Dagobah playtests and signed cards. That thread is the source Encyclopedia 3.2 cites for unreleased product.<ref name="forum" /><ref name="encyc" />

A later Google document, ''Reflections Gold Remastered'', rebuilds the frames as cleaned card images (blank text boxes, corrected layout) from those playtest stickers. Credit that reconstruction to its document author; it is not a Decipher print file.<ref name="doc">[https://docs.google.com/document/d/17TqWsm6AtmGREZlerTsMWjy5K9qfaamf/edit Reflections Gold Remastered] (Google Doc)</ref>

Category One still lists singles. A 2026 r/starwarsccg thread tracks which physical copies collectors believe still exist.<ref name="reddit">[https://www.reddit.com/r/starwarsccg/comments/1t4kb7c/reflections_gold_history_tracker/ Reflections Gold history tracker] on Reddit</ref><ref name="buylist">[https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398 Category One Games Reflections Gold buylist]</ref>

== Card list ==
Image columns are labeled by '''source'''. '''Forum post''' is the original Category One Photobucket dump in [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?f=87&t=18282 t=18282] (the album JPEG linked from each <code>postimage</code>, not the on-page thumb). Current Photobucket responses overlay a Groupsy watermark on those files.<ref name="forum" /> '''Category One''' is the current buylist photo for that title ([https://www.categoryonegames.com/buylist/star_wars_ccg-reflections_gold/398 buylist]).<ref name="buylist" /> '''Talaga Drive''' is a high-resolution reconstruction from [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1MgdLgCSaNFWN46hCrVhFNDv4fzrJ0jKe Andy Talaga's Reflections Gold folder] in the MPC print-ready Drive (not a Decipher print file).<ref name="talaga" /> The Drive has no separate filename for the combo '''The Circle Is Now Complete & Vader's Obsession'''; that row uses the Drive file ''circle is now complete corrected.png'' (combo layout). The landscape Circle-only Enhanced reconstruction (''The Circle Is Now Complete.png'') is the standalone Circle row. A later Google Doc reconstruction (''Reflections Gold Remastered'') remains in Sources.

Category One photo: [https://crystalcommerce-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photos/857036/refgold-governertarkin.jpg refgold-governertarkin.jpg] ([https://web.archive.org/web/20260927211916/https://crystalcommerce-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photos/857036/refgold-governertarkin.jpg Wayback 27 September 2026]). Forum list also types Kraty Dragon Bones (table currently uses Krayt pending a printed-title check). C1 splits Vote Now! as Light Side and Dark Side photos. Encyclopedia 3.2 listed a standalone Trade Federation Tactics; the forum set list and C1 have the combo Trade Federation Tactics & We're Hit Artoo instead.
